findings.title: Outdated OpenSSH
findings.description: Detected: OpenSSH 6.6.1p1. This OpenSSH version is old and has known vulnerabilities. Fix: Upgrade to a supported, patched version.

findings.title: Outdated Apache 2.4.x
findings.description: Detected: Apache/2.4.7 (Ubuntu). This Apache release is older than 2.4.49 and is missing many later security fixes. Fix: Upgrade to a supported, patched version.

findings.title: HTTP without HTTPS
findings.description: Port 80 is open but 443 is not, so traffic is unencrypted. Fix: Enable HTTPS and redirect HTTP to it.

findings.title: Missing header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.description: No CSP, so injected scripts are not restricted by the browser. Fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header.

findings.title: Missing header: X-Frame-Options
findings.description: The page can be embedded in other sites (clickjacking). Fix: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: Missing header: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.description: Browsers may guess content types (MIME sniffing). Fix: Add X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.title: Missing header: Referrer-Policy
findings.description: Full URLs may leak to other sites in the Referer header. Fix: Add a Referrer-Policy header.

findings.title: Software version disclosed
findings.description: The service reveals its version (OpenSSH 6.6.1p1), which helps attackers pick exploits. Fix: Hide or minimise version banners.

findings.title: Software version disclosed
findings.description: The service reveals its version (Apache/2.4.7 (Ubuntu)), which helps attackers pick exploits. Fix: Hide or minimise version banners.
